name: BigBasket Mini
description: Indian quick-commerce grocery storefront, rider dispatch and operations console; desktop shoppers, on-the-go delivery fleet, and operations admins
build_now: Choose the smallest useful set of features from the user's scope that delivers the fastest aha moment through a complete core workflow, honoring explicit user priorities.

overview: Category: food service & retail; sub-category: online grocery marketplace & delivery operations.
Users and usage: Indian household shoppers on desktop and mobile, delivery riders on mobile updating order milestones, and warehouse admins managing catalog and dispatch.

What suits it: clear Indian grocery taxonomy, bold vegetable-crate green primary, prominent prepaid Razorpay badges with flat ₹40 delivery fee callout, dense stock tables for admin, and large action buttons for riders.

Concept: Indian Kirana & Dark Store Harvest—clean shelf pricing, bold unit tags (1 kg, 500 g), and strict prepaid verification. Brand moment: Fresh harvest basket motif on sign-in and customer top navigation.

User choices: Clerk email/password auth, 100% prepaid Razorpay only (no cash on delivery), flat ₹40 delivery charge, AI shopping assistant chat & admin sales insights, rider sign-up with admin vetting.
This design is deliberate: its fonts, colours, flat surfaces, spacing and calm motion take precedence over generic visual defaults.
colors: Brand hue: Harvest Forest Green (#2e7d32, shade 700) reflecting BigBasket freshness and trust, paired with neutral slate-gray (#f8f9fa background, #212529 text). Accent red (#c62828) for discounts and prepaid COD-restriction alerts.
The primary marks the main action, the selected item, links and focus; everything else stays neutral.

Statuses: Placed and Paid mapped to info; Packed and Assigned mapped to warning; Out for Delivery mapped to warning-container with dark text; Delivered mapped to success; Cancelled or Payment Failed mapped to error; Rider Pending Approval mapped to warning.
typography: Plus Jakarta Sans from Google Fonts at 400, 500 and 600 for all work screens: clean geometric numerals and crisp legibility for Indian grocery packaging, weights and Indian Rupee amounts.

Labels 12px in on-surface-variant, the smallest size used. Amounts, counts, times and prices in tabular figures with ₹ symbol, upright and right-aligned in tables; order IDs left-aligned. Sentence case.
layout: Navigation: Storefront features clean top bar with location pin, search bar, category dropdown, AI assistant trigger, cart drawer pill, and role-switcher/account menu. Admin and rider consoles feature a compact sidebar navigation.
Content up to 1280px with 24px gutters; each page header has its title on the left and its main button on the right; 4px spacing grid, 44px table rows, 16px card padding.
Breakpoints: desktop from 1024px; tablet 768 to 1023px; phone below 768px with sticky bottom cart summary bar, stacked order cards, 44px touch targets and no sideways scroll.
elevation_and_depth: Flat: cards and tables have a 1px outline-variant border; one soft shadow only for menus, popovers and dialogs.
shapes: 8px corners on buttons, inputs and cards; 12px on dialogs; fully round for pills and avatars.
components: States: hover tints the surface, focus shows a 2px primary ring, disabled is dimmed, and a working button shows a spinner.
Names (people, clients, products, records) show in full and wrap to two lines; IDs, codes, dates, phone numbers and amounts stay on one line in a column wide enough for them.
Tables: numbers and their header share one right edge; the header row spans the table and stays visible while scrolling; 1px row dividers; most urgent first.
Status pills fit their word on one line rather than a fixed width.
Inputs have a visible label above; search fields leave room for their icon; errors sit under the field and keep what was typed.
Filter bars hold search and up to two controls in one row; other filters sit in a Filters panel with removable chips.
Key numbers: one bordered row, label above the value, no icon circles or sparklines.
Charts: bars from zero, one series in the primary, up to six labels, none overlapping.
Icons from one line-icon set; on work screens, images only from the user, otherwise initials. Motion: 150ms colour and opacity changes on hover and focus; nothing moves on its own.

Signature: Grocery product tile with discount tag, unit pill (500 g, 1 kg), strikethrough MRP, and green Add/Qty stepper; Prepaid Razorpay checkout breakdown card highlighting Flat ₹40 Delivery Fee and No COD notice; Rider milestone status stepper.
dos_and_donts: Do: one primary button per screen; clear prepaid disclaimer banner on cart and checkout; empty states that say what belongs there with 'Explore Fresh Produce'; 0 for zero, a dash for unknown; ₹ currency prefix for all amounts.

Don't: cash-on-delivery checkboxes or radio options, cream or beige pages, gradients, glass or blur, small uppercase labels above headings, 01/02/03 section numbers, monospace labels, cards inside cards, emoji icons.

screens: In build order; screen 1 is what the main user sees after signing in.

1. `/` Storefront & Catalog: Shoppers and guests; answers "What fresh groceries and pantry items can I order right now with flat ₹40 delivery?"; category rail, curated daily essentials grid, search & filter bar, item cards with Add-to-Cart steppers, floating AI assistant button; opens product quick-view modal; main action 'View Cart'.

2. `/cart` Checkout & Payment: Shoppers; answers "What is my order subtotal, flat ₹40 delivery fee, delivery address, and Razorpay payment confirmation?"; delivery address form, itemized breakdown with delivery fee tag, prepaid-only badge, Razorpay payment trigger; opens order confirmation modal; main action 'Pay with Razorpay'.

3. `/orders` Order Tracking: Shoppers; answers "Where is my grocery order and when will it reach my doorstep?"; live status tracker (Placed → Packed → Out for Delivery → Delivered), item summary, rider details; main action 'Order Again'.

4. `/delivery` Rider Fleet Console: Approved delivery personnel; answers "Which prepaid grocery orders are assigned to me for pickup and doorstep delivery?"; assigned order list sorted by dispatch time, customer contact and address, one-click milestone updates ('Picked up', 'Delivered'); main action 'Mark as Delivered'.

5. `/admin` Dark Store Operations Console: Operations manager; answers "What are today's sales, pending dispatch orders, inventory levels, and rider applications?"; KPIs row (Revenue, Orders, Low Stock, Active Riders), Order dispatch table with assign dropdown, AI Sales Insights summary drawer, Product inventory table with Add Product modal, Rider approvals queue; main action 'Add Product'.

6. `/sign-in` & `/sign-up` Authentication: Shoppers, riders, and admins; answers "How do I securely access my BigBasket Mini account?"; split brand card with fresh grocery value prop and embedded Clerk sign-in/sign-up widget; main action 'Sign In'.
first_run: Demo data: 18 grocery items across 6 categories (Fruits & Vegetables, Dairy & Bakery, Staples, Snacks, Masalas & Oils, Beverages) priced in ₹ with realistic units (₹42/kg Onions, ₹28/L Toned Milk, ₹110/kg Basmati Rice), 4 active orders with ₹40 delivery fee applied, 3 rider profiles (2 active, 1 pending approval), ₹18,450 daily revenue counter; realistic Indian sample addresses (Indiranagar, Koramangala Bengaluru).
The sign-in page shows the brand moment and the form, without sample credentials.
customer_pages: The action customers come for is finding daily groceries quickly and checking out securely with flat ₹40 delivery via Razorpay.
Trust from checkable facts: Official prepaid digital transactions, 100% fresh guarantee, Bangalore fulfillment hub address, and instant order tracking with verified delivery partners.
